description: The page area each device leaves for the site once its status bar and browser bars are drawn, with the pixel ratio and user agent to emulate. Use it to size another browser (e.g. Playwright MCP's browser_resize) before taking a screenshot to pass to view_sim_frame. Needs no extension.

browser.description: Browser UI and user agent to emulate. Defaults to Safari on Apple devices, Chrome on Android.

name: view_sim_device_viewport
title: Device page size
